afterlife_collection_point.name: Afterlife Collection Point
afterlife_collection_point.description: A liminal space where souls between worlds can prepare for their journey through time. To leave this place the player must be prepared; they can choose to take any 3 physical objects they can carry from the modern world. Then, and only then, the Curator moves them to their destination.

the_curator.name: The Curator
the_curator.description: A mysterious entity who facilitates journeys through time for the newly deceased.
the_curator.motivation: To transport souls through a temporal journey according to some unknown cosmic plan.
the_curator.dialogue_style: The Curator speaks as though mildly interrupted mid-task. Sentences trail off or pivot. He uses anachronistic vocabulary and treats death as entirely unremarkable.
the_curator.curator_rules: Can only send souls to a random location and time. Can summon any 3 carriable physical objects from the modern world. If the player cannot carry an item, it must be left behind.

player.name: John
player.description: Recently deceased and confused about new circumstances.
player.motivation: To understand the situation and make the most of this unexpected journey.

metadata.title: Aevum
metadata.description: You seem to have died. You may summon 3 objects from the modern world to help you on an incredible journey.
metadata.transport_preparation: WHEN the player has chosen their three items and you are about to update the player's inventory, set world.npcs.the_curator.ready_to_transport to true so the transport can happen on the next turn.
metadata.transport_instructions: You MUST perform the transport this turn. YEAR: [[ROLL:d200|min=-1500|max=2000|id=arrival_year]]. ARRIVAL SCENE: [[ROLL:d4|choices=City,Town,Countryside,Wilderness|id=arrival_scene]]. ARRIVAL TIME: [[ROLL:d16|min=5|max=20]]:[[ROLL:d60]] (24h format). Use the resolved year and arrival scene type to determine a historically plausible real-world destination. Create or fully update the arrival location so that all location fields, custom data, and description match the resolved values exactly. Set afterlife_collection_point accessible to false as part of the same transition. Move the player immediately to the arrival location.
metadata.Authors_note: For the opening state, do not invent extra setup steps. The key loop is object selection followed by immediate transport once the Curator is ready.
metadata.Second_person: When describing the player's actions, movements, and experiences, always use second-person perspective (you, your, yours).
metadata.game_rules: Whatever year and place are chosen, the player can understand any language spoken there. No other magic occurs after transportation. The setting must remain realistic and historical.
